name: Ollama
summary: MIT app and API for running open models locally, plus a paid Ollama Cloud with usage credits and per-token prices.
description: Established project (repo ollama/ollama; not archived; created 2023-06-26; not presented as a 2026 launch). Root LICENSE is MIT (Copyright Ollama). GitHub latest release v0.40.16 was published 2026-11-09T18:21:19Z. README documents macOS/Windows/Linux installers (including https://ollama.com/install.sh, not executed) and the official Docker image ollama/ollama. Local models on your own hardware are documented as always unlimited. Docs at https://docs.ollama.com (HTTP 200) also cover tool calling and connecting coding agents, plus an official Python client: PyPI ollama 0.6.3 (not yanked; uploaded 2026-09-29; repository ollama/ollama-python, also MIT). Real money — Ollama Cloud (vendor: Ollama), verified from https://ollama.com/pricing and docs.ollama.com/cloud on 2026-11-13, no signup: cloud inference requires an Ollama account and API key. Plans listed: Pay as you go at $0 (pay per token, no subscription, 3 concurrent requests, no service fees); Pro $20/month or $200/year ($16.67/month if billed annually) with $60 of usage credits per month; Max $100/month with $300 of credits and 10 concurrent requests; Team (early access) $500/month with $1,000 of shared credits, unlimited users and centralized billing; Enterprise custom. Included monthly credits do not roll over; they reset on the subscription anniversary day. Usage beyond included credits is pay-as-you-go at the per-million-token rates in the pricing table (input, cached input, and output; some models list off-peak rates outside 12:00–18:00 UTC on weekdays and all day on weekends). That table is authoritative at purchase time and is not copied here in full. Cloud FAQ/pricing: prompts and responses are not used for training; hosting is primarily in the United States and may route to Europe; Ollama says it collaborates with NVIDIA Cloud Providers under no-logging / no-training / zero data-retention requirements. Cloud features can be disabled to stay local. No account or key was created.

agent_access.notes: Local server and CLI need no Ollama account. Cloud and https://ollama.com/api require an account and API key; none were created. Official Python client is pip install ollama.
